findings.subject: VAR-childyr
findings.title: `VAR-childyr` reads prelude `MOD-DEM-childyr_mask`: The masking only applies `age < 5`; it does not guard against sentinel/invalid numeric ages (e.g., negative sentinel codes) that would still satisfy `<5` and be written into `__derived.childyr__`, violating the intended invariant and VAR-childyr range/universe. Consider explicitly treating sentinel/invalid values as missing (e.g., replace known sentinel(s) with NaN and also require `0 <= age < 5`). Evidence: prelude code in t8#prelude and target contract in t6.
